video_title: 为什么我开始减少工作流里的工具？
audience: Chinese-speaking knowledge workers interested in focus and simpler workflows
visual_hook: One strong visual metaphor for bringing scattered pieces into a clear order; do not suggest numerical performance gains
subject: One oversized cobalt-blue horseshoe magnet on the right, drawing a small scattered group of cream paper clips into a single clean aligned line. Treat the magnet and clips as one graphic metaphor, with recognizable silhouettes rather than many tiny details.
scene_details: Warm cream paper field, deep navy ink and cobalt blue. Flat screen-print shapes with restrained halftone only inside the magnet, crisp edges and generous negative space. Huge dark headline on the left. No border, labels, brands or realistic people.
